sentences.text:
Applicant :- Prashant Singh @ Virendra Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Mishra,Dhirendra Babu Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 03.11.2019 as well as the entire proceedings of Case No.192 of 2019, arising out of Case Crime No.294 of 2019,
under Sections-498A, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, Police Station-Pipari, District- Kaushambi, pending in the court of JM, Kaushambi.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is husband of opposite party No.2.

The parties have reconciled their differences and compromise have entered between them which has Prashant Singh @ Virendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69768214/
1 been reduced in writing.

entities.text: Prashant Singh @ Virendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Compromise deed has been filed as annexure 4 to the affidavit.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the facts.
5. Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order on the next date fixed.

It is therefore expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
It shall be open to the applicants to file a fresh application U/S 482 at that stage for the relief sought herein.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of five weeks, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicant.

Order Date :- 15.12.2023 Nitin Verma  Prashant Singh @ Virendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69768214/
